start.text: You there. You look like capable fighters. I have a job, if you've got the stomach for it.
start.speaker: Kael

explain.text: My brother Daren fell in with a bandit gang. They've been raiding travelers on the road near Frontier Camp.
explain.speaker: Kael

request.text: I need him captured alive. Not killed. Use the Subdue skill when he's weakened, and tie him up before his friends can free him.
request.speaker: Kael

offer.text: Capture Daren, and I'll join your company. I'm a bounty hunter by trade. If he dies... I'll pay you 80 gold, but we part ways after that.
offer.speaker: Kael

accept.text: Good. Daren's gang has been spotted on the road between here and Frontier Camp. Travel that way and you'll find them. Remember — use Subdue on weakened enemies to tie them up.
accept.speaker: Kael

decline.text: Suit yourself. I'll be here if you change your mind.
decline.speaker: Kael
